name: Solara Minerals Ltd
summary: Solara Minerals Ltd is an Australian enterprise focused on the exploration and discovery of mineral deposits. The company actively seeks a variety of valuable resources, including gold, nickel, copper, cobalt, niobium, lithium, iron oxide, and platinum group elements. Founded in 2021, the firm, which was initially incorporated as Lycaon Resources Limited, officially transitioned to Solara Minerals Ltd in March 2025. Its operational base is situated in Perth, Australia.
